content:
name: publish-alpha

on:
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  publish-alpha:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' && github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]' && github.actor != 'mergify[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:

      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      # trusted publishing over OIDC needs npm >= 11.5.1
      - run: npm install -g npm@latest

      - run: npm ci

      - run: npm run build

      - run: npm version --no-git-tag-version $(git describe --abbrev=0 --tags)-alpha.$(git rev-parse --short=6 ${{ github.sha }}) || true

      # authenticated over OIDC, provenance is generated automatically
      - run: npm publish --tag alpha || true
